title: Typed text entry
text: Text, email, URL, phone, search, and password types with matching keyboards and autocomplete.

title: Shared validation
text: Required, length, pattern, and custom checks with localized messages identical in every browser.

title: Counter and addons
text: An optional character counter plus prefix and suffix text such as units or domains.

title: Password helpers
text: A reveal toggle and a clipboard policy that can block copying or pasting.

title: Message timing
text: Show validation on blur, on input, or only on submit.
